subject: STABLE lowering-opus B2 + B1 (gate-green 15:42-15:52, host-only): targeted waits instead of full reaps; CA released at commit under kernel 0112 reservation, today's path on pre-0112
body: B2: bridge keeps the handles of this context's 64 newest kernel jobs; n2mb_wait_handles WAIT_SEQs only to the newest unreaped job listing a given buffer (flushes an open chain holding it). Shadow sync waits only for shadows whose IOSurface seed changed (tegu_shadow_refresh_handles); mid-command CPU work waits only for its own buffers (blit src/dst, re-expansion index/source/out, preclear dst); events keep the full reap. TEGU_PERF_ASYNC adds mid=blit/expand/preclear/event mid_waits shadow_waits=waited/checked early_commit. B1: -commit: eligible pipelined command (async bridge, pipeline A/B, no shadow write-back) -> cached 0112 probe -> depth-2 throttle (moved to commit) -> RESERVE imported surfaces it writes (targets incl. sidecar MRT/resolves, clear targets, blit dst; bridge filters to imports, <=8) -> status 3 immediately; executor runs scheduled handlers, submits, RETIREs with the command's newest job id (0 = cancel on error). NORD2_METAL_EARLY_COMMIT=0 disables. Pre-0112 / refused: previous behaviour (throttle not repeated). Tests: bridge 23 PASS x3 (targeted waits, 0112 reserve/filter/probe/Unsupported); async frontend 7/7 incl. new FA_B1 (gated execution: status 3 at commit with 0 submits, completes 4); A/B PASS; CA PF0/PF1 rc=0; render harness rc=0; iOS syntax x5; integration = known CA stride; run_host_tests = known strict-link step. Shared fake gained a 0112 model (off = Unsupported). md5(12): compute_frontend.m eea6a81ab255; compositor_submit.inc 055cb3c21fed; nord2_metal_bridge.c 7630b1f70af6; nord2_metal_bridge.h 2dda07bc667c; nord2_metal_bridge_test.c 12449d954d40; async_frontend_test.py c2dd5ab402a3;  NOT device verified; device check: TEGU_PERF_ASYNC early_commit>0 and sched_us ~0, kernel log resv= counters, no tearing on swipe.
